title: Vistra acquires Energy Harbor and its nuclear fleet for $3B cash

sources.quote: Total compensation will consist of $3 billion cash and a 15% equity interest in Vistra Vision.

explain: Vistra paid Energy Harbor's owners $3 billion in cash plus a 15% stake in its new Vistra Vision unit (and took on ~$430M of debt) for Energy Harbor's nuclear and retail businesses. That deal gave Vistra the Ohio and Pennsylvania nuclear plants it later contracted to Meta. Plants acquired: Perry, Davis-Besse and Beaver Valley nuclear plants.
